title: alchemilla glaberrima var. major
intro: Alchemilla glaberrima var. major, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial flowering plant of the family Rosaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating menstrual disorders, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These compounds may contribute to the plant's antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, making it a subject of interest in modern herbal medicine.
